Specification: A high-level voting algorithm in which a set of acceptors cooperatively choose a value. Acceptors cast votes <<b,v>> in ballots and a value is chosen when a quorum votes for it in the same ballot. Develops the SafeAt / ShowsSafeAt machinery, defines IncreaseMaxBal and VoteFor actions, and proves Spec implements Consensus via theorems including AllSafeAtZero, ChoosableThm, VotesSafeImpliesConsistency, ShowsSafety, and Invariance.
DivisionNotes: TypeOK, VotedFor, ChosenAt, DidNotVoteAt, CannotVoteAt, NoneOtherChoosableAt, SafeAt, VotesSafe, OneVote, OneValuePerBallot, ShowsSafeAt, and Inv are placed in OperatorDefNames_StatePredicate because they are predicates over the current state (no primed variables, no top-level temporal operators).
Spec is the unique temporal definition (Init /\ [][Next]_<<votes,maxBal>>) and is placed in OperatorDefNames_TemporalProperty.
Init is the initial-state predicate (var = value form) and is placed in OperatorDefNames_Init.
Ballot (a constant set Nat) and chosen (a state function over Value) are placed in OperatorDefNames_ValueDef.
IncreaseMaxBal, VoteFor, Next are placed in ActionDefNames as they contain primed variables (maxBal', votes') or disjunctions of actions.
FunctionConstructor entries are partitioned: [a \in Acceptor |-> ...] forms in ByDomain; [Acceptor -> ...] forms in SetType.
UNCHANGED votes references a single variable identifier and so is placed in UnchangedExprs_VarRef.
TemporalNesting is false: temporal operators ([][Next]_vars and []Inv) appear only at top level without nesting.
VerificationTools is empty: the module does not extend TLC and is intended for TLAPS proof checking; the TLC harness is the separate MCVoting module.
